h.format: w[word] = "pos|nounGroups|verbGroups" (pos: n and/or v as WordNet lists the word; groups = comma-separated indexes into g, "*" = the word's first WordNet sense); g[i] = space-separated members of one kept synset (a dominant sense — first or second, ≥25% of the word's tagged uses — for every member; single words in the vocabulary; members 50× rarer in work text than the commonest dropped; person nouns only as one-word O*NET titles of a shared occupation). Every vocabulary word is in w, with or without groups — it is also the lexicon for lemmatisation.
